display.name: PSV Bollinger Fade
display.description:
bollinger(20, 2σ) on 5m sol. close above the upper band we sell it, below the lower we buy it, inside the bands we hold nothing and quote.

the profit-share version: no promised interest. depositors buy shares, and their value floats with the strategy's pnl. the manager takes a 10% carry on profit when shares are withdrawn, plus a 1%/yr management fee that accrues continuously. buy while the share price is low and you get more shares.
